2025-11-17: updating test suide to use plugins and public rpc interface

2026-07-20: Created dev_docs/embed_python.md — comprehensive feasibility analysis and plan for embedding libpython in EigenD. Key decisions: bundle full stdlib (~67MB), keep system Python fallback with logging, build CPython from source (--enable-shared) for macOS/Linux (standard approach, like Blender/Calibre), use python.org embeddable package for Windows (standard Windows embedding approach). All runtime Python deps are stdlib-only; no PIP/plugin changes needed. Added Phase 0 macOS PoC plan (dev-machine quick test only, copies from installed framework). Added §10 explaining build-from-source as the standard approach vs the PoC shortcut. Windows Python26 cleanup and Linux Python26 verification planned as separate tasks.
